name: DominoFund – Donation & Fundraising
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
DominoFund is a lightweight and straightforward plugin for accepting donations. It provides a simple settings page to configure a donation message and a shortcode [dominofund] that can be placed anywhere on your site to display your donation link or message.

Built with performance and simplicity in mind, it’s a great way to start your fundraising campaign on WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dominofund-donation-fundraising folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings -> DominoFund to configure your donation message.
  4. Use the shortcode [dominofund] on any page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I use the plugin?

Simply go to the Settings -> DominoFund page, set your message, and place the [dominofund] shortcode on any post or page.
